title: Local Cilium validation of workload-specific controlled egress
objective: Use disposable probes to verify the Prysm and Nethermind NetworkPolicy allowlists in the local Cilium cluster.
acceptance: Prysm probe allows only its DNS, TCP/UDP 13000, and HTTPS gateway paths
Nethermind probe allows only its DNS, TCP/UDP 30303, and HTTPS gateway paths
Wrong port or wrong destination is denied
All disposable probe/gateway resources are deleted after the test
